rec.name: Cart Drawer Up-/Cross-Sell Block (Product-Metafield Driven)

what.text: A 'Goes perfectly with it' (German: 'Passt perfekt dazu') up-sell/cross-sell block inside the cart drawer. It shows a headline, a social-proof sub-headline ('8 out of 10 customers also buy'), and a vertical list (or carousel, depending on the display setting) of recommended products. Each product shows an image, title, star rating, current and compare-at price, a green 'You save X €' note, and a yellow 'ADD' button. Products are chosen per cart item through a product metafield 'Cart upsell' (a list of products). If the product in the cart has no metafield value, the block falls back to the global theme-settings list 'Cart upsell products'.

why.text: Shoppers are at their highest purchase intent in the cart, so a one-click add of a complementary item raises AOV with little friction. The sub-headline uses a social-proof claim ('8 of 10 customers also buy'), which normalises the add-on. Star ratings reduce doubt about the extra item. The struck-through price with the green 'You save' amount frames the add-on as a deal. Metafield-driven selection keeps recommendations relevant to the specific cart item (e.g., a bathroom set suggests the ALL IN set and the refill bottle), which beats a generic list.

how.text: 1) Create a product metafield 'Cart upsell' (list of product references). 2) In the cart drawer snippet, loop over cart items and collect the products referenced in each item's metafield, skipping items already in the cart. 3) If no metafield products are found, fall back to the theme-settings 'Cart upsell products' product list. 4) Render each card with a snippet (upsell-product-temp) showing image (6x6rem), title, rating snippet, price/compare-at price/savings, and an Add button that adds via the cart AJAX API. 5) Expose theme settings for layout, copy, colours and toggles for teaser, price and reviews. The star-rating snippet link had to be fixed so reviews display correctly.

items: Display Settings: Vertically (list) or horizontal carousel
Cart upsell sub-headline (e.g. '8 von 10 Kunden kaufen zusätzlich')
Product metafield 'Cart upsell' (list of products, set per product)

dependencies.text: Product metafield definition 'Cart upsell' (list of product references); theme cart drawer with snippets upsell-product-temp and product-rating (a review app's rating data is needed for the stars; the app is not named in the source); theme settings section 'Cart upsell'. Built on the goldkindchen/main theme. The prices use compare-at price.

images.caption: Product admin: 'Cart upsell' product-list metafield with selected upsell products per product
Theme settings: Cart upsell headline, sub-headline and global fallback product list
Theme editor with all Cart upsell options (colors, teaser/price/reviews toggles) next to the cart preview
Cart drawer with the horizontal carousel layout of the upsell block
Final cart drawer: vertical upsell list with 6rem images, star ratings, savings and yellow Add buttons
